title: A Teenager Discovered a New Planet While Doing a School Project

paragraphs.text: A 17-year-old student from New York made an amazing discovery last week. While working on a school science project with a small telescope, he found a new planet outside our solar system. Scientists at NASA later confirmed his finding. The news quickly spread across the internet, and many people called him a young genius.
paragraphs.translation: 上周，一名来自纽约的17岁学生在学校科学项目中取得了惊人的发现。他用一台小型望远镜发现了一颗太阳系外的新行星。美国宇航局的科学家后来确认了他的发现。这个消息迅速在网上传开，很多人称他为少年天才。

paragraphs.text: The planet is about six times bigger than Earth. It is very far away — more than 1,000 light-years from us. The planet goes around a star that looks a lot like our sun. Scientists say the surface of the planet is extremely hot, over 800 degrees, so there is probably no life there. But the planet's atmosphere is still very interesting to study.
paragraphs.translation: 这颗行星大约是地球的六倍大。它离我们非常远——超过一千光年。这颗行星围绕着一颗看起来很像太阳的恒星运行。科学家说这颗行星的表面极其炎热，超过800度，所以那里可能没有生命。但这颗行星的大气层仍然非常值得研究。

paragraphs.text: The discovery is still very important. It shows that young people can do real science, not just read about it in textbooks. The student, named Jack Chen, spent three months looking at data from his school's small telescope. He said he almost missed the evidence because the signal was very weak. 'You need a lot of patience,' Jack said. 'But when you find something, it feels amazing.'
paragraphs.translation: 这个发现仍然非常重要。它表明年轻人也可以做真正的科学研究，而不仅仅是在课本上读到它。这位名叫Jack Chen的学生花了三个月时间查看学校小型望远镜的数据。他说他差点错过了这个证据，因为信号非常微弱。Jack说：“你需要很多耐心，但当你发现什么东西的时候，感觉太棒了。”

paragraphs.text: NASA has invited Jack to visit their space center this summer. He will meet real astronomers and learn more about how to explore the universe. Jack said he plans to study physics in college and hopes to discover more planets in the future. 'I just wanted to finish my school project,' he said with a smile. 'I never thought I would find a whole new world.'
paragraphs.translation: 美国宇航局已邀请Jack今年夏天参观他们的航天中心。他将见到真正的天文学家，并学习更多关于如何探索宇宙的知识。Jack说他计划在大学学习物理学，希望将来能发现更多的行星。他笑着说：“我只是想完成学校项目，从没想过会发现一个全新的世界。”
